title: The Last Echo Revisited
author: Wren Vasquez
blurb: Marguerite Yarrow, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
